rationale: B1 and B2 concern actual model evidence handling across turns and appropriately declare prompt_behavior and runtime_interaction risks. Required cases cover both bounded behavioral acceptance IDs.

B1 final strict JSON equality checks retention of supplied counts, absence of invented real interviews and absence of proven demand. Earlier source status and omission assertions supplement that bounded final-state claim.

B2 combines json_field_nonempty and json_field_length_at_most on features, requiring one to three array entries. Nonempty participant, action, measure, threshold and basis fields require an immediate proposed experiment structure; final strict equality retains the student decision, precommitted criterion, assumption and not-run status.

D1 and D2 inspect documentation and execution evidence, with explicit empty-risk applicability rationales; neither represents executable deterministic product logic. Their mandatory independent inspection and source-scope obligations remain in force.
Empty prohibited lists have explicit forbidden-behavior rationales. Supported local operators provide reproducible narrow assertions; no arbitrary grader execution is proposed.

repair_findings.finding: Previously eight replies did not establish total contacts, yet the oracle required contacted=8. The reviewed input now explicitly states exactly eight people contacted and all eight replied, supporting the expected value without inference.

limits: This approves classifications and bounded scenario design, not an execution result or product acceptance.

Structural operators do not establish semantic feature quality, observed-problem linkage, feasible participant/action design, measurable threshold quality, question count or relevance. Actual intermediate transcripts require independent semantic review; strict final equality cannot repair earlier fabrication.

Question-mark presence alone does not establish one to five appropriate coaching questions. Name and HTTPS omission checks alone do not establish absence of every fabricated source or unsupported claim.

Ten actual evaluation cases and a full session require independent review of all original acceptance criteria, including inquiry sequence, four deliverables and cited supporting excerpts or explicit unverified/no-research labels. Missing or failed evidence blocks delivery even if machine assertions pass.
Static canonical prompt identity does not prove live Claude chat parity; live parity remains unverified unless actually executed.
Actual replay proves bounded tool-free conversation behavior, not native persistence, browsing or cross-surface parity. Hosted model alias is not an immutable backend version.
A separate different-provider typed prototype challenge and subsequent development/final gate evidence remain required.
